# Master Prompt

Use this document as the high-level creative brief for the project.

## Project Summary

Describe the celebrant, the audience, and the emotional goal of the site.

## Non-Negotiable Rules

Include:

- British English
- no accidental em dashes
- APC requirements
- imagery restrictions
- copy duplication guardrails

## Creative Direction

Summarise the intended visual and emotional direction.

## Brand Direction

List the colour and typography cues that should drive the build.

## Imagery Direction

Describe the imagery world and what should be avoided.

## Motion Direction

Explain the level and style of animation expected.

## Implementation Expectation

State the desired stack and overall quality bar.

## Final Self-Check

List the questions the build should satisfy before review.
